create_pipeline_subclass: create a subclass of Pipeline that implements __init__ and __call__ for a custom model
implement_pipeline_call: implement the __call__ method in a Pipeline subclass to process input data
raise_pipeline_exception: raise a PipelineException when a pipeline operation encounters an error
review_pipeline_abc: review the Pipeline abstract base class to understand required methods for subclasses
test_pipeline_subclass: test a Pipeline subclass by instantiating it with a model_id and calling it with inputs
